releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 修复授权问题。
- 修复开启虚拟 Wi-Fi 后列表为空的问题。
- 修复部分情况下保存的 Wi-Fi 环境没有正常显示的问题。
releaseNotes.en:
- Fixed authorization issues.
- Fixed an issue where the Wi-Fi list was empty after virtual Wi-Fi was enabled.
- Fixed an issue where saved Wi-Fi environments were not shown correctly in some cases.
